capabilities: Track aggregate vault metrics (file count, note count, size) as a baseline
Warn when file count, note count, or vault size falls below thresholds
Check the vault after startup, periodically, and after file events
Run commands to check the vault now or reset the baseline
disambiguation: Not a backup tool; it only raises an alert and explicitly tells you to keep separate backups or version history for recovery.
extras: README states it is local-first with no network requests or telemetry, only stores aggregate metrics (not note contents), requires Obsidian 1.13.0+, and defaults to Japanese UI strings with English available. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. BRAT is mentioned only as an install method for pre-release builds.
problem: Large-scale file loss from a sync mistake, broken automation, or another tool can go unnoticed for hours or days, and Obsidian has no built-in alert for it.
summary: A vault monitoring plugin that warns when visible file count, Markdown note count, or vault size drops beyond configurable thresholds.
